text:
maria_cs: FYI Valence Health (enterprise) submitted a bespoke security questionnaire asking for KMS/HSM rotation proof + audit log export. They also reported intermittent 401s on embeddings and a p95 latency spike yesterday. They want all evidence by end of day Thu (48h). Ticket #52319.

oliver_support: I triaged and asked for a sample request-id. Customer sent back one: `req_2026-03-15-7b9c`. Added to ticket. I attached a small snippet of their failing request below.

maria_cs: (from customer) "embedding call returns 401 sometimes; header has Authorization: Bearer <token>. We see errors around 2026-03-15T18:42:11Z, request id req_2026-03-15-7b9c"

maria_cs: paste of the request they sent:
```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json

{ "input": "patient note..." }
```

maria_cs: And a short log line they included: `2026-03-15T18:42:11Z ERROR req=req_2026-03-15-7b9c status=401 msg="invalid token" svc=redwood-embed`

devon_eng: @maria_cs thanks. I'll take the auth/latency side. Two immediate asks: 1) can you paste the internal backend trace for req_2026-03-15-7b9c (we need downstream service span ids)? 2) can you confirm whether this customer is on Dedicated or Hosted? 401 + intermittent latency could be token rotation timing or a routing mismatch.

oliver_support: Customer is on Hosted (standard org). I've asked for full trace and the JWT (header+payload only) so we can inspect the `exp` and `aud`.

karen_security: For the questionnaire: to provide KMS key rotation proof and HSM attestation we need to run the audit export and the HSM attestation report generator. Steps: 1) run `redwood audit export --org valence-health --since 2026-02-01 --until 2026-03-15 --format ndjson` 2) for HSM: `redwood keys hsm-attest --key-id projects/valence/keys/primary --output hsm_attestation.pdf` 3) collect key rotation logs: `redwood keys rotations --key-id projects/valence/keys/primary --format csv` 4) include a signed statement about rotation windows and who approved. I'll assemble the template for the questionnaire mapping. :white_check_mark:

audit-bot: Audit export job started: job_id=ae-99821 user=karen_security org=valence-health timeframe=2026-02-01..2026-03-15

sam_se: If this is a hard deadline we should ask for a short extension (3 business days) while we confirm HSM attestation. @maria_cs can you ask and flag that we will provide interim evidence (audit logs + rotation CSV) by the current due date?

maria_cs: yes I asked for extension. Customer replied "if we can get the logs and rotation CSV by Thu EOD that will keep us moving; attestation PDF can come within 72h". They're okay with that as long as there's clear proof the attestation is forthcoming.

devon_eng: Re: 401 — common cause is token audience mismatch after a key rotation event. When you get the JWT (no secret), run: `echo \"<JWT>\" | cut -d'.' -f2 | base64 -d | jq .` and check `exp` and `aud`. Also send the internal trace. For latency: can you share p50/p95/p99 for embeddings between 2026-03-15T18:30..19:00 and whether the calls hit the edges or were routed to Dedicated fallback?

oliver_support: I exported the request trace from our tracer and uploaded secured s3 link to the ticket: s3://secure-exports/52319/traces/req_2026-03-15-7b9c.json (access granted to eng + security).

audit-bot: Audit export completed: job_id=ae-99821 file=s3://secure-exports/52319/audit_export_ndjson.gz size=4.2MB

karen_security: I started HSM attestation run but note: the customer uses a non-default rotation policy (30-day auto-rotate). I'll include the rotation CSV plus a signed change log and the attestation PDF when ready. Also adding the CAIQ mapping rows we usually provide (controls and evidence mapping).

sam_se: I'll send an email to the customer's security lead summarizing what we can deliver by Thu and request the 72h window for the attestation PDF.

maria_cs: Quick repro details from customer for the 401: they say it happens on long-running batch jobs (1000 requests/min) after ~20 minutes. They suspect token caching. They attached this curl that reproduces a 401 in their environment:
```bash
for i in {1..120}; do 
  curl -s -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d '{"input":"test"}' 
  sleep 1
done
```

devon_eng: That pattern screams stale token reuse when rotation happens. Two things to check on our side: 1) key rotation timeline (karen, did rotations happen in that window?) 2) any gateway cache of tokens or inconsistent token validation shards. I'll look at the token validation service logs for the req id timeframe.

karen_security: Rotation CSV shows a rotate event at 2026-03-15T18:35:02Z for the key used by Hosted. We'll include that in the rotation CSV and highlight it in the evidence package.

oliver_support: I zipped audit export + rotation CSV + trace and uploaded: s3://secure-exports/52319/evidence_bundle_v1.zip. Shared with customer link with expiration 2026-03-22.

maria_cs: Customer acknowledged receipt and said they can validate p95 improvements once we share interim evidence. They still want final attestation PDF though.

sam_se: Great. I'll follow up for extension. @karen_security once attestation PDF is in draft let me know and I'll push to their legal/sec team.

maria_cs: thanks all — keeping ticket updated. Will close the loop here when customer confirms. :bow:
